channel.title: Active-Directory on Ghost Graph
channel.description: Recent content in Active-Directory on Ghost Graph

item.title: Troubleshooting Group Policy Objects (GPOs)
item.description: A collection of useful commands and steps for troubleshooting Group Policy Objects (GPOs) in a Windows Active Directory environment.

item.title: Active Directory User Lockout and Password Report
item.description: A PowerShell script that generates an HTML diagnostics report for user lockouts in Active Directory, including password age, expiration details, and account status.

item.title: Join a Workstation to Active Directory with Shell and PowerShell
item.description: A comparison of efficient one-liner commands in both Shell and PowerShell for joining workstations to Active Directory domains with proper credential handling and automatic restart functionality.

item.title: Windows ACL Management with PowerShell
item.description: A comprehensive collection of PowerShell scripts for managing Windows Access Control Lists (ACLs), including permission enumeration, modification, and analysis tools with detailed permission descriptions.

item.title: Managing Global Address List (GAL) Visibility with PowerShell
item.description: A comprehensive guide to managing user visibility in the Global Address List (GAL) using PowerShell, covering both on-premises Active Directory and Exchange Online environments with detailed scripts for checking and modifying the msExchHideFromAddressLists attribute.
